provider: Alfred Wegener Institute (AWI) / PANGAEA Helgoland Roads series
contact_route: Principal investigator named on PANGAEA 10.1594/PANGAEA.960407 and 10.1594/PANGAEA.862910
what_is_requested: Licence terms and access for the carbon- and biovolume-resolved Helgoland Roads annual datasets
why_it_mattered: All 28 carbon and all 24 biovolume children state an unknown licence requiring author contact. Only the abundance children are CC-BY. This is the only identified source able to express lifeform dominance as a carbon share directly.
availability_treatment: partially_open: the 128 open-licence abundance children are used; the 289 contact-required carbon and biovolume children are not
consequence_applied_now: DS08 is used as a Tier C high-frequency abundance sentinel, not a Tier A carbon reference. Lifeform dominance must be derived from abundance through the pinned DS22 PEG_BVOL coefficients at every source, with conversion uncertainty propagated.
revisit_trigger: A reply granting licence terms for the carbon or biovolume children

provider: Landesamt fuer Landwirtschaft Umwelt und laendliche Raeume Schleswig-Holstein (LLUR)
contact_route: PLET restricted-dataset request route for OSPAR_LLUR-SH_2010-2020
what_is_requested: Data delivery plus method metadata and licence terms
why_it_mattered: Fills the German coastal sector and the Phaeocystis monitoring gap, inside the CMEMS era.
availability_treatment: contact_required: unavailable at the current stage
consequence_applied_now: The German coastal sector is covered by DS04 alone. The reduced independence is declared at Stage 4 as an observation-adequacy limit.
revisit_trigger: A reply delivering the data or a public release

provider: Niedersaechsischer Landesbetrieb fuer Wasserwirtschaft Kuesten- und Naturschutz (NLWKN)
contact_route: PLET restricted-dataset request route for OSPAR_NLWKN_1999-19_phyto
what_is_requested: Data delivery plus method metadata and licence terms
why_it_mattered: Long Lower Saxony coastal record with OSPAR relevance.
availability_treatment: contact_required: unavailable at the current stage
consequence_applied_now: The Lower Saxony sector is unrepresented. Recorded at Stage 4 as an observation-adequacy limit, not as an ecological absence.
revisit_trigger: A reply delivering the data, or discovery of an open DOME or EMODnet copy at Stage 2

provider: Institute of Marine Research (IMR) Norway and the Norwegian Marine Data Centre
what_is_requested: Whether analyzable phytoplankton cell-count and species-composition files exist for the North Sea Ecosystem Survey, and their licensing
why_it_mattered: Northern offshore coverage. The 2025 IMR monitoring plan states no phytoplankton database had yet been developed.
availability_treatment: no_route: resolves to no retained registry row
consequence_applied_now: The northern offshore gap is treated as structural. Offshore evidence rests on DS12 CPR through its open OBIS route, at Tier D/E only.
revisit_trigger: A reply confirming that analyzable files exist

contact_route: IMR data support enquiry; may be combined with DS19
what_is_requested: Digitized taxon and biovolume access for the Norwegian coastal and Torungen series
why_it_mattered: Potentially fills Skagerrak and Norwegian inflow gaps in the external-transfer region.
availability_treatment: no_route: resolves to no retained registry row
consequence_applied_now: The transition region rests on DS06 and DS26 alone. The single-provider dependence is recorded, since both are SMHI holdings.
revisit_trigger: A reply identifying a digitized series

contact_route: Publisher contact for the 2016-2017 Ferrybox flow-cytometry functional-group dataset
what_is_requested: Release status, and if released the data plus method metadata and coordinates
why_it_mattered: The pico/nanophytoplankton stratum is conditional on this dataset in README section 8.
availability_treatment: no_route: unresolved in the executed search, consistent with the register's report that it is not released
consequence_applied_now: The pico/nanophytoplankton stratum stays exploratory. The DS16 Stonehaven flow-cytometry resource is the only cytometric route.

provider: Marine Biological Association / Continuous Plankton Recorder Survey
contact_route: CPR Survey data request and collaboration route at cprsurvey.org
what_is_requested: A custom North Sea route extract with taxon counts, Phytoplankton Colour Index, and sampling-effort metadata
why_it_mattered: The only evidence of any tier for the offshore central and northern North Sea.
availability_treatment: open_route_archived: the CPR phytoplankton dataset is reachable through its open OBIS/EurOBIS route, so DS12 is NOT blocked
consequence_applied_now: The offshore arm proceeds on the open OBIS CPR extract at Tier D/E. The request seeks better sampling-effort metadata than the aggregator copy carries; it is an improvement, not a dependency.
revisit_trigger: A reply offering the custom extract
